Accuracy study of the `github.blockers` answer. It covers 44 real pull requests in 5 public repositories, graded against ground truth computed from GitHub's API at one recorded snapshot. The brick arm and a native raw-REST arm both run on `claude-sonnet-5-5` and replay the same fixtures. ## Headline (first snapshot, brick 1.0.0) | Answer | Verdict right | Blockers found | Overcalls | Fabricated | Cost | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | brick (raw payload and + Sonnet, identical) | 44/44 | 21/111 | 16 | 0 | $0.27 total | | native + Sonnet | 42/44 (2 truncated at output cap) | 52/111 | 0 | 0 | $4.61 total | The study found three brick bugs, F1–F3. All have one cause: required checks and approvals came only from admin-only branch protection. - **F1. Overcalls.** 16 non-required failing or pending checks were reported as blockers on 10 PRs. - **F2. Missing reviews.** A required review was never named, on 24 of 24 PRs. - **F3. Never-run required checks.** All 66 were missed, or reported as "an unidentified branch rule". ## Re-run after the fix (second snapshot, brick 1.0.0 vs 1.1.0 back to back) The fix is #874. On a second snapshot (CI run `40218094404`, about 18:00 UTC), each PR was asked of both bricks: | Answer | Verdict right | Blockers found | Overcalls | Unattributed | Every blocker found | Cost | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | brick 1.0.0 | 44/44 | 19/109 | 13 | 6 | 3 of 28 PRs | $0 | | brick 1.1.0 | 44/44 | **109/109** | **0** | 0 | **28 of 28 PRs** | $0 | | brick 1.1.0 + Sonnet | 44/44 | 109/109 | 0 | 0 | 28 of 28 PRs | $0.33 | The doc states the limit on this result. Brick 1.1.0 now reads the GitHub sources the rubric is computed from, so the full agreement shows it applies them without error; it is not independent evidence. The native arm was not re-run. Spend: $5.10 for the study and $0.33 for the re-run. Each time the key was used only as an env var and unset afterwards. ## What changed - `docs/benchmarks/blockers-accuracy.md`: the written rubric, method, results, findings with their fix status, the re-run, limits and the per-PR table. - `tools/blockers-accuracy/`: the harness (capture, fixtures, truth, run, score), both snapshots (`fixtures/`, `fixtures-rerun/`) and the raw runs. - `capture.py --extra` asks a second host build. - `run.py --arms` runs only the arms named. - `score.py --fixtures/--brick-dir` grades another snapshot or brick build. - `docs/DocsIndex.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased), and the regenerated knowledge graph. ## Verification - `scripts/ci/run-repo-gates.sh`: all 41 gates pass. - `verify-doc-anchors.py`: passes. - The staged diff was scanned for key and token patterns; none found. - `python3 tools/blockers-accuracy/score.py …` re-grades offline. Master is frozen for 0.4.0, so this branch is not rebased.
